The real request supplies the Instagram reference, $75.00 conditional pay, September 19, 2026 deadline and personal note.

keep: The 200px graphite rail, restrained TapMart lockup, mineral canvas and 32px main gutter match the approved shell.
The source and decision columns retain the 24px desktop separation. The white ledger is flat and square, without generic card borders or shadows.
The recipient and unboxed portrait-format work remain visible alongside the decisions. The pay caption starts 24px inward from the source edge.

review.readiness_note: Visual sign-off at 1440×900. The capture exposes the required data, conditions, navigation and actions, but cannot verify request submission, link destinations, recipient binding or accounting execution.
review.why: This is a credible purpose-specific transfer, not a reproduction of the Lab’s Content screen. The production capture preserves the mineral/graphite/white surface hierarchy, operational typography, open source treatment, offset monetary caption and restrained cobalt commitment. Its work preview is compact, but the recipient, work context and explicit reference inspection remain available beside a complete final ledger. All send-step information and controls fit comfortably within the viewport. The copy does not imply escrow, reserved credit, payment on sending or a platform fee added above the $75.00 pay. No release-blocking visual or financial-semantic drift is evident.
review.verdict: Frame Shift was faithfully adapted to this request send step, with the required functionality visibly preserved and no capture-visible release blocker.
